definitions.energy: Energy for labelling: EU Regulation 1169/2011 factors, with protein as N x 6.25 and available carbohydrate as sugars + starch (documentation 5.1-5.3)
definitions.carbohydrate: Available carbohydrate: total carbohydrate by difference (dry matter minus protein, fat, ash, organic acids and residual) minus dietary fibre, not below 0 (documentation 5.2, Table 5.2)
definitions.vitaminA: Retinol equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene / 6 (documentation 6.1; the UK and EU definition; US targets use retinol activity equivalents)
definitions.vitaminD: Vitamin D2 + D3 + 2.5 x (25-hydroxy vitamin D2 + D3) (documentation 6.2)
definitions.niacinNE: Niacin equivalents as published by Frida: niacin + tryptophan / 60; for cereals tryptophan only (documentation 6.6)
definitions.folate: Total folate, all folate-active substances (documentation 6.10; not dietary folate equivalents)
